MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The memory cards fit my repeated purchases of storage cards and a card reader. The 128GB card feels like a useful next option, provided my devices support it.",
    "The HDMI cable connects with my TV, DVD player and practical accessory purchases. It could meet a familiar need if the ports and length are right."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The outdoor Ethernet cable and DIRECTV remotes require specific projects or equipment needs that my purchases do not establish.",
    "Buying cables does not mean any cable is useful: the male-to-male USB cable does not match a replacement I need, and the HDMI switch assumes I need several sources connected.",
    "The larger Fire tablet and streaming stick are appealing possibilities, but owning related devices does not mean I currently need another one. The smart display has no clear purpose for me."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as interest in a broad range of electronics, although I usually choose accessories for particular tasks.",
    "My storage purchases support recommending memory cards, but they do not establish a need for the highest capacity or fastest option. I would favor the 128GB card over the 256GB card this time."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Compatibility matters: my history includes several distinct cable connectors and memory-card formats, so a similar-looking accessory is useful only if it fits my equipment.",
    "My Fire tablet purchase was followed closely by a memory card and case, which suggests completing a device setup rather than repeatedly replacing the device.",
    "My repeated tripod purchases and most recent lens-cap purchase make practical camera accessories a clearer continuing interest than smart displays or outdoor networking equipment."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my storage and accessory interests but stretched them into equipment purchases without a clear current need."
}
